paragraphs: Agra. Agra, Rabbi Abba’s father-in-law, recited; another reading, Rav Dimi’s father-in-law, chapter Kol Habbasar 104b. Chapter Hakometz 29, end of a: he came to Rabbi Abba. He is an amora despite the wording “recited.” Rashi’s commentary: “Rami bar Chama recited.” (See the rules.)
